items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: My godfather was my teacher. He... His name was Paul Shalini. Paul Shalini. He died a few years back. He was my teacher.

ctx.x: I used to play on the chairs. I mean on the higher net, who was your teacher?
Oh, who was my teacher? Well, my... My godfather was my teacher. He... His name was Paul Shalini. Paul Shalini. He died a few years back. He was my teacher.

Oh, by the way, is this... We talked to Mr. Glenny the other day and he said there was an old bass player. The first one he heard used to play with you. It was the first one that began picking. Perdonce? John Perdonce? John Perdonce? It might have been John Perdonce. Do you remember... By your time they were all picking a good deal, I guess. Yeah, everybody was picking. Yeah, everybody was picking that time. My time. So you started on drums just in the kitchen, you say. Then you didn't have a drum to start on.
